title: The impact of isolation measures during covid-19 pandemic on russian students’ motivation for learning
reason: Questionnaire and testing study of learning motivation (motives, difficulties, attitudes to distance learning) among 107 undergraduates during lockdown on Microsoft Teams. All data are self-report; no platform-recorded indicator or activity product is analysed.
